mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_status_log ( account_id, prev_status, new_status, changed_at, reason ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{prevStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{changedAt}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_status_log WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY changed_at ASC, log_id ASC
SELECT * FROM account_status_log WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY changed_at DESC, log_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM account_status_log WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND prev_status = new_status AND reason LIKE 'LIMIT_CHANGE|%' ORDER BY changed_at DESC, log_id DESC

SELECT changed_at FROM account_status_log WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND new_status = 'APPLIED' AND ( prev_status IS NULL OR prev_status = 'REJECTED' ) ORDER BY changed_at DESC, log_id DESC LIMIT 1
